title: 长句的修饰与并列
goal: 确定后置修饰语的归属，识别并列成分及共同修饰语。

points.label: 确定修饰语所依附的成分
识别并列成分及其共同修饰语

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 阅读理解能力的课程安排

body.p: 后置修饰语放在被修饰的词后面，用来限定对象或补充信息。并列结构连接功能相同的成分。修饰语可能只修饰其中一项，也可能同时修饰几项。

body.box: The books on the table and the maps in the cabinet belong to the archive.

body.p: on the table 修饰 books，in the cabinet 修饰 maps。books 与 maps 并列，共同作 belong to 的主语。

cards.title: 后置修饰语
rows: 定语从句
The map that shows the old route is on the desk.
that 从句修饰 map
定语从句
The volunteers who signed up received a schedule.
who 从句修饰 volunteers
分词短语
The letters stored in the archive are available as copies.
stored 短语修饰 letters
分词短语
The guide leading the tour is a volunteer.
leading 短语修饰 guide
介词短语
The books on the upper shelf belong to the school.
on 短语修饰 books
介词短语
The notice beside the entrance describes the schedule.
beside 短语修饰 notice

cards.title: 并列成分
rows: 并列名词
The museum displays maps and photographs, both from the town archive.
maps 与 photographs 共用来源短语
并列名词
Both the chairs and tables in the hall are new.
chairs 与 tables 共用 are new
并列谓语
Volunteers collect and inspect the returned tools.
collect 与 inspect 共用主语及宾语
并列谓语
The guide opened the room and explained its history.
opened 与 explained 共用主语
并列分句
The hall opened in May, and the garden opened in June.
两个分句各有主语和谓语
并列分句
The group prepared the list, and the office printed it.
两个分句分别说明准备与打印

body.box:
The guide collected maps and photographs, both from the archive.
Which items came from the archive?
1. The guide and the archive
2. The maps and the photographs
3. The maps but not the photographs
4. The guide but not the photographs

body.p: maps 和 photographs 并列，both from the archive 同时修饰这两项。答案是第二项。

groups.text: The letters stored in the archive describe the old route.

items.stem: What is stored in the archive?
options: The old route itself
Letters describing the old route
A description of the archive
The route leading to the archive
items.why: stored in the archive 紧跟 letters，修饰 letters。存放的是描述旧路线的信件，即第二项。

groups.text: The guide who leads the tour prepared the schedule.

options: The people on the guide's tour
A guide other than the schedule's author
The guide who prepared the schedule
A person chosen by the guide
items.why: who leads the tour 紧跟 guide，修饰 guide。带队的向导也是 prepared the schedule 的主语，即第三项。

groups.text: Both the chairs and tables in the hall are new.

items.stem: Which items are described as new?
options: The hall with its chairs
Only the tables
Only the chairs
The chairs and tables
items.why: both 标明 chairs 和 tables 共同对应 are new。

groups.text: The office received and checked the forms.

items.stem: What did the office do with the forms?
options: It received and checked them.
It received but did not check them.
It checked but did not receive them.
It returned them without checking them.
items.why: received 和 checked 并列，共用 the forms 作宾语。

groups.text: The report on the trial lists costs, and the notice beside the door gives the schedule.

options: The trial
The notice
The report
The schedule
items.why: beside the door 修饰 notice。

items.stem: What do the two clauses state?
options: The report gives the schedule and the notice lists costs.
The report and the notice both list only costs.
The report lists costs and the notice gives the schedule.
The notice lists costs and gives the trial report.
items.why: and 连接两个分句；各自的主语和谓语分别是 report lists 与 notice gives。

groups.text: The student who prepared the map borrowed a book from the archive.

options: The student who borrowed the book
The archive that lent the book
A student who lent a book to the archive
Someone who borrowed the student's map
items.why: who prepared the map 紧跟 student，修饰 student。这个学生也是 borrowed 的主语，即第一项。第三项把借书的方向说反了。

groups.text: The office collected the forms and checked their dates.

options: It checked the dates but did not collect forms.
It collected forms and checked their dates.
It collected dates and checked the forms.
It collected forms but did not check dates.
items.why: collected 和 checked 是 office 的并列谓语。

groups.text: The photographs displayed in the hall show the former station.

items.stem: What is displayed in the hall?
options: The former station
Pictures of the hall
Photos of the station
The hall of the old station
items.why: displayed in the hall 紧跟 photographs，修饰 photographs。展出的是旧车站的照片，即第三项。

groups.text: The hall opened in April, and the garden opened in May.

items.stem: Which statement matches the two clauses?
options: Both the hall and garden opened in April.
Both the hall and garden opened in May.
The garden opened before the hall.
The hall opened before the garden.
items.why: 并列分句分别给出四月和五月，因此大厅先开放。

groups.text: The notes beside the map describe the walking route.

options: The walking route itself
The notes describing the route
A map showing the walking route
The route marked on the map
items.why: beside the map 紧跟 notes，修饰 notes。地图旁边是描述路线的说明，即第二项。

groups.text: The archive keeps letters and photographs, both donated by residents.

options: Both the letters and the photographs
The letters but not the photographs
The photographs but not the letters
The archive and the letters it keeps
items.why: both donated by residents 共同限定并列的 letters 和 photographs。
